This '''unknown executive''' was the chairman of the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] company coalition that controlled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Belthu]]. The chairman was a supporter of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="WS" />

During [[Ession Strike|''Night Caller's'']] visit to Belthu, the chairman spoke with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Zurel Darillian]], who was [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Garik Loran]] in disguise, and provided him with a price list for the world's latest stockpile of [[Ore/Legends|ores]].<ref name="WS" />
